verdict.rationale: Linear ships a first-party, built-in Linear Agent that users can hand work to. It writes code via Claude Code and Codex, sets up, runs and tests that code, and investigates and attempts fixes on new issues. It also drafts updates via 'Write with Agent', edits text, and runs recurring Loops, and delegated issues get their own tracked section under My Issues. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how well the built-in agent performs delegated tasks (the community evidence predates the agent and does not address it).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Linear Agent can now write code using Claude Code and Codex. You can triage, plan, review, and ship—all in Linear.
We’ve also added section under My Issues → Assigned for your delegated issues. It shows the status of each coding session, and gives you a quick way back into active work.
When a new issue is reported, Linear Agent can investigate and attempt a fix before it reaches an engineer, reducing the load on your team.
click Write with Agent to let Linear do it for you. The agent reviews changes made since the last update, checks messages in the linked Slack channel, and writes an update draft for you to refine.
Loops are a new way for Linear Agent to take on recurring work for your team.
Linear Agent can now set up, run, and test your code before returning its work.
